Assassinate the three members of the [[White Mantle]] inner council.  

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill [[Inner Council Member Argyle]].
* Kill [[Inner Council Member Bolivar]].
* Kill [[Inner Council Member Cuthbert]].
* Talk to [[Captain Grumby]].
* See [[Fogard Axemighty]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]

===Environmental changes===
* After accepting this quest's reward, the Inner Council Members (Argyle, Bolivar, and Cuthbert) and White Mantle will no longer [[spawn]] in [[Perdition Rock]].

==Walkthrough==
This quest may prove difficult for players discovering Perdition Rock for the first time due to the high density of foes and patrols that can easily cause [[aggro]]. 

Exit [[Ember Light Camp]] into [[Perdition Rock]]. The first area has many patrols of [[Mahgo Hydra]]s, [[Flesh Golem (NPC)|Flesh Golems]] and [[Dark Flame Dryder]]s that will gather in front of you, then go counterclockwise around the central pit of lava. 

It is possible to follow them and clear them one by one, but it is faster to wait until after the last patrol of Flesh Golems is gone and head north, with only a lone hydra that may spawn along the way.

Be careful around the [[Mahgo Hydra]]s, as they possess [[Meteor Shower]]. Either spread your team, or [[interrupt]] the skill, but note that their elite [[Glyph of Renewal]] may cause it to recharge instantly.

You should arrive at your first [[Ether Seal]]. It is an [[Air Magic]] elementalist foe that is a massive annoyance to spellcasters due to its ward effect [[Mursaat Tower (skill)|Mursaat Tower]] causing high energy denial and enchantment removal. You should try to deal as much damage as possible and as quickly as possible. Martial professions are at an advantage; a [[Ranger]] with a [[longbow]] or [[flatbow]] can do significant damage to the seal without needing to enter the ward, by standing on the promontory, and a [[warrior]] can rely on [[adrenaline]] skills to get damage through. Some [[Jade Bow]]s and another group of foes are also in the vicinity, but it is generally possible to engage the Ether Seal without aggroing them.

Then take the central road to the northwest, defeating the members of the White Mantle along the way. Aside from a few [[Breeze Keeper]]s, most of the wildlife of Perdition Rock can be avoided. 

Eventually you should arrive at the docks, with the three members of the inner council, one [[Warrior]] and two [[Mesmer]] bosses, atop a shrine guarded by two pull-able groups of White Mantle. The bosses are not part of the surrounding groups, so you can safely clear the area before running up the steps and take on the bosses. 

After the fight, talk to [[Captain Grumby]] who will send the party directly to the [[Ring of Fire (outpost)|Ring of Fire]].

== Notes ==
* If you have killed the council but keep the quest in your Quest Log without accepting the reward, then the council and the White Mantle will still spawn when you revisit Perdition Rock but you don't need to kill them again in order to have Captain Grumby send you to the Ring of Fire.

== Trivia ==
* The first initial of each of the three White Mantle council targets in the order in which they are listed are A, B, and C.
